scoring_justification: Headline quantities are final computed values; raw DFT intermediate artifacts are not submitted. Feasible tier: compare reported values to paper‑reported reference within tolerance and verify structural trends (inverted volcano / volcano).

outputs.description: Formation energies of FeN_x (x=1..5) computed from DFT total energies. The hidden checker compares each value to paper-reported reference values and verifies that FeN4 is the minimum (inverted volcano).

ORR overpotentials of FeN_x (x=1..5) computed from free energy diagrams. The hidden checker compares each value to paper-reported reference values and verifies that FeN4 has the lowest overpotential (volcano trend).

output_contract.notes: The contract requires exactly one row per coordination number x=1..5 in each file. The checker will also verify the inverted volcano trend in formation energies and the volcano trend in overpotentials.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference formation energies and ORR overpotentials for FeNx (x=1..5) from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper‑reported DFT results (DOI 10.1039/c9ta08532g, J. Mater. Chem. A, 2019). Formation energies: FeN1 –1.24 eV, FeN2 –2.50 eV, FeN3 –3.97 eV, FeN4 –5.10 eV, FeN5 –2.25 eV (Fig. 4a, Table S6). Overpotentials: FeN1 1.04 V, FeN2 0.79 V, FeN3 0.75 V, FeN4 0.46 V, FeN5 1.17 V (Fig. 4a, Table S7).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published article (figure and supplementary tables).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the published computational results; they serve as the gold target for reproduction.

steps.description: Formation energy of each FeNx must lie within ±0.3 eV of the reference, and FeN4 must have the lowest formation energy (lower than FeN3 and FeN5).
ORR overpotential of each FeNx must lie within ±0.15 V of the reference, and FeN4 must have the lowest overpotential (lower than FeN3 and FeN5).
